title: Pawn Stars
description:
S03 E01 — Peeping Pawn
The team is presented with a rare 1776 Massachusetts penny made by Paul Revere; Rick has an opportunity to buy a hand grenade made by an American World War II spy program; Rick and Corey meet a man hoping to sell his 1950s peep show machine.

title: American Pickers
description:
S09 E08 — Traders of the Lost Parts
The guys scour an extraordinary New Jersey collection; Mike finds a rare 1911 Harley motor he needs to complete a project; Dave's heavenly stockpile.

title: American Pickers
description:
S19 E20 — One Wheel Deal
In Missouri, the guys visit an historic homestead where they join the search for grandpa's lost Civil War uniform.

title: American Restoration
description:
S03 E27 — Big Boom
A 1900s signal cannon is brought into the shop; the shop attempts to hold their first auction; 1950s Italian folding bicycle.

title: American Restoration
description:
S03 E11 — Pump & Gun
Rick and his crew take a shot in the dark when a 1943 trap machine lands in the shop; Ron and Tyler find a rare rusty pump while on the road.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S03 E26 — Wise Guys
The Pawn Stars are presented with a fully functional 1941 M3 Armored Scout Truck from World War II; Rick and Corey meet a man hoping to sell a check signed by notorious mobster Carlo Gambino; Rick and Chumlee check out a 1987 Apple II GS Computer.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S03 E02 — Ace in the Hole
The team is presented with an antique professional gambler's toolkit; Rick and Corey look to buy rare pieces of 1896 U.S. currency; a man hopes to sell his 1950s radiation detecting Geiger counter.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S03 E04 — Getting a Head
The guys are presented with a 1969 Buick Skylark; Chumlee and the Old Man look to buy a Civil War field desk complete with captured Confederate documents; Rick is presented with a human shrunken head.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S03 E06 — Ready, Set, Pawn
A seller brings in a competition dragster racecar; Rick and Corey are presented with a Japanese land mine training kit used during World War II; Corey and Chumlee check out a fully restored 1957 Dr. Pepper vending machine.

title: American Pickers
description:
S06 E03 — Mike's Holy Grail
The guys get a vague lead on the holy grail of motorbikes; Mike puts pressure on Danielle to track down a XAVW; Betty's sprawling warehouses; Dale's awesome junkyard and a noble cause.

title: The World Wars
description:
S01 E02 — A Rising Threat
After the fighting stops, tensions continue to simmer just beneath the surface, and few realize that the seeds of the next great global conflict have already been sown; Jeremy Renner narrates.

title: The World Wars
description:
S01 E01 — Trial by Fire
An assassin's bullet sparks a global conflict that evolves into one of the deadliest wars in history; a generation of soldiers emerges, including a group of men who will become the most infamous leaders of the 20th century; Jeremy Renner narrates.

title: Mail Call
description:
S01 E05 — Landing Craft, Air Cushion Hovercraft (LCAC); U.S. Cavalry Saddles; Gas Masks
Operating the LCAC; cavalry saddles, used in the Old West; how gas masks work.

title: The World Wars
description:
S01 E03 — Never Surrender
World leaders are called to action as war inevitably breaks out again; the men who came of age during wartime must rely upon experiences to fight a new conflict, as they face the greatest challenge humanity has ever seen; Jeremy Renner narrates.
